testcase.name: TodoItemComponent should have the checkbox checked and class completed for a completed todo
TodoItemComponent should call onToggle when the checkbox is clicked
TodoItemComponent should call onDelete when the delete button is clicked
TodoItemComponent should create
TodoItemComponent should display the todo text
TodoItemComponent should have the checkbox unchecked for an incomplete todo
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-high" for high priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-low" for low priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-low" as default
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-medium" for medium priority todos
GodService User Management Responsibility should get a list of users
GodService User Management Responsibility should log when adding a user
GodService Product Management Responsibility should log when adding a product
GodService Product Management Responsibility should get a list of products
GodService To-Do List Responsibility should toggle a todo completion status from false to true
GodService To-Do List Responsibility should get initial todos
GodService To-Do List Responsibility should toggle a todo completion status from true to false
GodService To-Do List Responsibility should add a new todo
GodService To-Do List Responsibility should delete a todo
GodService Logging Responsibility should log a message
GodService Configuration Management Responsibility should log when updating a config value
GodService Configuration Management Responsibility should get a config value
GodService should be created
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent template rendering should display "No important outstanding to-do items!" message when list is empty
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent template rendering should display the list when there are important todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent should create
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos should filter by priority
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos should filter by completion status (completed)
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos should return all todos sorted by id when no filters are applied
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos should filter by completion status (incomplete)
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos should filter by both priority and completion status
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent computed signals should correctly compute importantTodos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent computed signals should have an empty importantTodos list if no todos match
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent computed signals should update importantTodos when the source signal changes
App should create the app
